Quality Assurance (QA) Crusader at BuildBear Labs - Web3 Edition 
 Do you thrive on unearthing hidden bugs and polishing software to perfection? BuildBear Labs , a trailblazing DevTools platform building for the Web3 revolution, seeks a passionate QA Person with Web3 superpowers to join our crusade for exceptional quality. You'll be the guardian of our code, ensuring our tools shine on every front, including the cutting-edge world of decentralized applications (dApps).
 Must Haves:

• 
 Testing Wizard: 3+ years of experience crafting and executing test plans across manual and automated testing for software applications.

• 
 Tool Master: Expertise in industry-standard QA tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, Appium) and familiarity with blockchain testing tools. 

• 
 Bug Detective: Keen eye for detail and a relentless drive to identify, document, and report software defects, including gas optimization and smart contract functionality. 

• 
 Communication Ace: Collaborate effectively with developers and product teams to resolve issues and provide actionable feedback, keeping Web3 complexities in mind. 

• 
 Documentation Dynamo: Maintain clear and concise test cases and defect reports, clearly outlining any Web3-specific aspects. 

• 
 Web3 Toolbox Mastery: Hands-on experience with a variety of Web3 tools, including: 

• Safe Wallet SDK

• The Graph

• Chainlink

• ThirdWeb

• WalletConnect

• Tenderly

• Alchemy

• Infura

 Join the Revolution:

• Work alongside talented developers and product thinkers to craft industry-leading DevTools for the Web3 space.

• Shape the user experience by proactively identifying and eliminating bugs before they reach customers, especially within the context of complex dApp interactions. 

• Test and validate integrations with various Web3 tools to ensure seamless user experiences.

• Own your quality journey, exploring innovative testing methodologies for Web3 applications and contributing to process improvement.

• Stay abreast of the latest developments in Web3 tooling and testing methodologies.

• Champion a collaborative and growth-oriented environment where your contributions are valued and your Web3 expertise shines.

 Become the quality champion BuildBear Labs needs in the Web3 age. Apply now and unleash your testing prowess on the blockchain!
